title: The Secret Life of Reading Eyes
author: Gaze Reader Press
blurb: A friendly pocket guide to what your eyes really do while you read, from tiny jumps and skipped words to how a webcam can tell when you’ve reached the last line.

title: Dewey and the Midnight Library
author: Gaze Reader Press
blurb: Locked in the library at midnight, a sleepless reader meets Dewey, a very small and extremely earnest resident of shelf 020, who is determined to help her finish the book she has been stuck on for months.
